summary: In this fiction excerpt, a narrator and his friends Darryl, Van and Jolu hunt for a signal with wifinders. A pink-haired girl in Japanese-style dress photographs them and threatens to report them to truant watch unless they leave the clue to her team. Before the standoff resolves, an earthquake hits, with a roaring sound and a huge black cloud rising from the northeast.
one_line: Teen narrator and friends track a wifinder clue until a rival girl's snitch-cam standoff gives way to an earthquake and a black cloud.
key_facts: Darryl and Van have phones with built-in wifinders, while Jolu carries a separate little directional fob.
The narrator tells the group to fan out and look for a sharp drop in signal that gets worse the more they move along it.
A girl with bright pink hair, a sharp rodent-like face and big sunglasses snaps the narrator's picture and says "Cheese," calling it candid snitch-cam.
The pink-haired girl threatens to send the photo to truant watch in thirty seconds unless the four back off from the clue.
She offers that the narrator's group can return in one hour and the clue will be theirs, saying this is more than fair.
Three other girls in similar garb have blue, green and purple hair.
The pink-haired girl says her team will kick the narrator's team's ass at Harajuku Fun Madness.
The pink-haired girl wears striped tights beneath a black granny dress with Japanese decorer toys safety pinned to it.
Van's all-girls school is notorious for its brawls, and Van starts forward ready to knock the girl's block off.
The narrator feels the cement lurch, the sickening sensation every Californian knows instinctively as an earthquake.
The narrator's first inclination is to run, but the group is already in the safest place, away from buildings and falling cornice.
The roaring sound of the quake is louder than anything the narrator has heard before and drives him to his knees.
Darryl points over the buildings and the group sees a huge black cloud rising from the northeast.
